how_built: Read from the C2 files that are in git: research/data/agency_profile/*.json, crawl/tree.json, crawl/changes.jsonl, seed_urls.yaml, research/docs/drp_completion_log.md, extraction_design.md, service/app/core/extraction/vocabulary.py, contracts/naming.md. The extracted facts themselves (fee amounts, document lists) live in C2's Postgres (c2 schema) and Neo4j, and the page text in crawl/archive/ (gitignored). None of those were available, so attribute status below says where a value is, not what it is.

id_status.confirmed: The id is used by C2 in real (non-test) data or docs and the service has facts in the graph.
id_status.confirmed_no_facts: The id is used by C2 in real data, but C2's log says no facts were written for it yet.
id_status.proposed: No such service exists in the KG yet. The id follows contracts/naming.md and the C2 vocabulary, and must be agreed with C2 (C2 owns the service vocabulary).

attribute_status.reported_in_graph: C2's completion log reports approved facts of this kind written to Neo4j. Not checked against the database.
attribute_status.on_crawled_page: A crawled and saved page for this service carries the discovery signal (F = fee, D = documents, P = prerequisites), or the C2 docs quote it. Not yet extracted into the graph.
attribute_status.form_links: Form or document links are in the agency profile (PUBLISHES_FORM). The files are linked, not read.
attribute_status.agency_level: Only agency-wide contacts or offices are known, not a per-service office list.

attributes_available.service_types: normal and one_day (the one-day service has its own page; the C2 vocabulary keeps one_day as a qualifier separate from urgent)
attributes_available.eligibility: not_found as a fact (free-text eligibility is held for human review)

sinhala_coverage.summary: No official Sinhala service names were scraped. Discovery drops the Sinhala and Tamil copies of pages by design, extraction reads English pages only, and the Sinhala/Tamil layer of the PDFs that were read came out garbled. All kg_service_name_si values are therefore null.
sinhala_coverage.where_to_get_them: The Sinhala copies exist and are linked from the crawled sites (immigration.gov.lk *_s.php, drp.gov.lk /si/ pages, rgd.gov.lk Sinhala menu). Getting official names needs C2 to crawl the Sinhala menu pages, or a manual pass.

Passport basis is normal/urgent in the KG; schema_v1 says normal/one_day. Which name does C4 show?
Plan to crawl the Sinhala pages, so that official Sinhala service names can be added?
Export the current service list (Neo4j Service nodes) to a file in git, so C1 can check its ids against it in CI.
